prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1051; do not mention it.)
text:
This office has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at a controlled intersection involving your insured. Our client was struck while proceeding through the intersection and has since undergone medical evaluation and treatment for significant injuries. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to the accident, including the claim file, recorded statements, photographs, vehicle data, repair records, and any dash camera or telematics information. Please treat this letter as formal notice to preserve all such materials pending resolution of our client's claim.
